description: Banggood's official Affiliate Data API provides read-only products, categories, prices and per-warehouse USD price fields. It requires partner-issued AppID/AppSecret mapped to api_key/api_secret, a documented MD5 token exchange, and a short-lived access-token. The documentation is version 1.2.2 with updates through 2021; no partner-issued credentials were available for independent live replay. See references/commerce-banggood-contracts.json.

capabilities.title: Search product data by keyword or category and collect requested-currency prices
capabilities.blocker: The client and signed-token path are implemented from the official API reference, but no partner-issued API key and secret were available for an independent authenticated HTTP replay. Page totals are returned; the official document does not specify a page request parameter, so full-catalog pagination is not claimed.

capabilities.title: Read a product by ID with per-warehouse prices, optional sale fields, and canonical product URL
capabilities.blocker: The official contract documents product detail and warehouse price fields. Independent live authentication and response validation await partner-issued API credentials. Warehouse prices and market prices are explicitly represented as USD decimal amounts, not stock availability or minor units. Optional sale_price and date fields are preserved raw; currency, timezone, and active-sale semantics are not inferred.

capabilities.title: Preserve optional warehouse sale price and raw sale date boundaries
capabilities.blocker: The official detail example contains sale_price, sale_date_start, and sale_date_end, but no partner-key response has been replayed. Date strings are retained as raw values; the PDF does not specify timezone or active-sale boundary semantics.

capabilities.title: Read the product category tree or a category by ID
capabilities.blocker: The official category contract is implemented locally, but no partner-issued API key and secret were available for independent live replay.

capabilities.title: Collect every product page using a documented continuation parameter
capabilities.blocker: The official API PDF returns page_total but does not specify a page index or page-size request field. No page parameter is sent or guessed.

capabilities.title: Read available quantity or in-stock status per warehouse
capabilities.blocker: The documented product-detail warehouse fields provide warehouse_price and market_price but do not define quantity or an in-stock signal. Price presence is not treated as stock evidence.

capabilities.title: Validate product-list prices across supported currencies
capabilities.blocker: The client accepts the documented currency parameter and preserves decimal amounts, but only USD is documented as the warehouse-price unit and no currency has been live-replayed.

capabilities.title: Generate and verify a publisher-attributed affiliate link
capabilities.blocker: This read-only product-data client strips the product_url query string and does not claim link generation or publisher attribution.

capabilities.title: Sign in to a Banggood consumer account
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The requested commerce data path uses partner API credentials, and customer-account login is outside this read-only product and price collection scope.

capabilities.title: Edit a Banggood consumer account profile
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Consumer profile operations are outside this read-only product and price collection scope.

capabilities.title: Create or pay for a dropshipping order
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The user requested product lookup and price collection; ordering and payment changes are outside this read-only API scope.
